title: NATO cuts off Kaliningrad, and Russia fires a nuclear warning on its own soil

strikes.launch_name: Polish Air Force strike package over northern Poland (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Day 8 of the crisis, five days before the nuclear step. Conventional NATO strike on the base that guards the sea inspection line; simulation choice, no source row, NATO denies planning any move against Kaliningrad (A2)

strikes.target_name: Marijampole rail and road junction, Lithuania (Via Baltica)
strikes.notes: Day 11, conventional reply on the corridor's transport node (A7, A26 names the town); Iskander range up to about 500 km (A11), brigade permanently in Kaliningrad since 2018 (B5)

strikes.target_name: Open forest and farmland, eastern Kaliningrad Oblast, Russian territory (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Day 13, demonstration burst on Russian soil, a simulation choice. Iskander-M is dual-capable (A11, CRS IF12672); no nuclear yield is published, 5 kt is OUR assumption for a low-yield warhead; first use justified in doctrine condition 4 (A18)
